1.explanation: We stub the Time-to-Interactive audit to ensure the SVG is considered loaded before TTI, then construct a single ImageUsage entry for an SVG pointing at ring.svg with clientWidth and clientHeight set to zero. The offscreen-images audit_ method sees the zero area, triggers the debugString “Invalid image sizing information,” and returns a result item that you can inspect to confirm the bug behavior.
1.bug_scenario: When the offscreen‐images audit is run against an SVG that reports zero width and height, the audit emits a debugString “Invalid image sizing information” and flags the SVG as offscreen, even though the real intent is to ignore SVGs.
